props.flavor_text: A Former bandits, and mercenary from the "Yudo Tribe" (Lizardfolks), he loves fighting, and holds a grudge against the Wiarachia Empire
props.name: Gushtar
props.support_active:
Roll a 【DEX】+【DEX】check against DL13, on a success, you stole an Equipment, Consumeable or Zenit from the target.

Each creature have one stealable item.
props.support_passive:
When targeted with an attack or offensive spell, you may activate this effect once per round:

  • If the attack hits, negate damage and any affect that would apply to the target. If the negated damage is 40 or higher, Gushtar cannot be activated again until the end of scene.
  • If the attack misses, deals 25 physical damage to the attacker.
